en.text: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

zhSimplified.text: 那时，耶稣在安息日从麦地经过。他的门徒饿了，就掐起麦穗来吃。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，耶穌在安息日從麥地經過。他的門徒餓了，就掐起麥穗來吃。

en.text: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

zhSimplified.text: 法利赛人看见，就对耶稣说：「看哪，你的门徒做安息日不可做的事了！」

zhTraditional.text: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌說：「看哪，你的門徒做安息日不可做的事了！」

en.text: But he said to them, “Haven’tyou read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「经上记着大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所做的事，你们没有念过吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「經上記着大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？

en.text: howhe entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

zhSimplified.text: 他怎么进了 神的殿，吃了陈设饼，这饼不是他和跟从他的人可以吃得，惟独祭司才可以吃。

zhTraditional.text: 他怎麼進了上帝的殿，吃了陳設餅，這餅不是他和跟從他的人可以吃得，惟獨祭司才可以吃。

en.text: Orhave you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

zhSimplified.text: 再者，律法上所记的，当安息日，祭司在殿里犯了安息日还是没有罪，你们没有念过吗？

zhTraditional.text: 再者，律法上所記的，當安息日，祭司在殿裏犯了安息日還是沒有罪，你們沒有念過嗎？

en.text: ButI tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

zhSimplified.text: 但我告诉你们，在这里有一人比殿更大。

zhTraditional.text: 但我告訴你們，在這裏有一人比殿更大。

en.text: Butif you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ youwouldn’ t have condemned the guiltless.

zhSimplified.text: 『我喜爱怜恤，不喜爱祭祀。』你们若明白这话的意思，就不将无罪的当作有罪的了。

zhTraditional.text: 『我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。』你們若明白這話的意思，就不將無罪的當作有罪的了。

en.text: Forthe Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为人子是安息日的主。」 （可3·1—6；路6·6—11）

zhTraditional.text: 因為人子是安息日的主。」 （可3‧1－6；路6‧6－11）

en.text: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣离开那地方，进了一个会堂。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌離開那地方，進了一個會堂。

en.text: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

zhSimplified.text: 那里有一个人枯干了一只手。有人问耶稣说：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。

zhTraditional.text: 那裏有一個人枯乾了一隻手。有人問耶穌說：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。

en.text: He said to them, “Whatman is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们中间谁有一只羊，当安息日掉在坑里，不把它抓住、拉上来呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們中間誰有一隻羊，當安息日掉在坑裏，不把牠抓住、拉上來呢？

en.text: Ofhow much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

zhSimplified.text: 人比羊何等贵重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」

zhTraditional.text: 人比羊何等貴重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」

en.text: Then he told the man, “Stretchout your hand.”He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

zhSimplified.text: 于是对那人说：「伸出手来！」他把手一伸，手就复了原，和那只手一样。

zhTraditional.text: 於是對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原，和那隻手一樣。

en.text: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

zhSimplified.text: 法利赛人出去，商议怎样可以除灭耶稣。

zhTraditional.text: 法利賽人出去，商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。

en.text: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣知道了，就离开那里，有许多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌知道了，就離開那裏，有許多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；

en.text: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

zhSimplified.text: 又嘱咐他们，不要给他传名。

zhTraditional.text: 又囑咐他們，不要給他傳名。

en.text: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 这是要应验先知以赛亚的话，说：

zhTraditional.text: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：

en.text: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 看哪！我的仆人， 我所拣选、所亲爱、心里所喜悦的， 我要将我的灵赐给他； 他必将公理传给外邦。

zhTraditional.text: 看哪！我的僕人， 我所揀選、所親愛、心裏所喜悅的， 我要將我的靈賜給他； 他必將公理傳給外邦。

en.text: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

zhSimplified.text: 他不争竞，不喧嚷； 街上也没有人听见他的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 他不爭競，不喧嚷； 街上也沒有人聽見他的聲音。

en.text: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

zhSimplified.text: 压伤的芦苇，他不折断； 将残的灯火，他不吹灭； 等他施行公理，叫公理得胜。

zhTraditional.text: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷； 將殘的燈火，他不吹滅； 等他施行公理，叫公理得勝。

en.text: In his name, the nations will hope.”
Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

zhSimplified.text: 当下，有人将一个被鬼附着、又瞎又哑的人带到耶稣那里，耶稣就医治他，甚至那哑巴又能说话，又能看见。

zhTraditional.text: 當下，有人將一個被鬼附着、又瞎又啞的人帶到耶穌那裏，耶穌就醫治他，甚至那啞巴又能說話，又能看見。

en.text: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

zhSimplified.text: 众人都惊奇，说：「这不是大卫的子孙吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 眾人都驚奇，說：「這不是大衛的子孫嗎？」

en.text: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

zhSimplified.text: 但法利赛人听见，就说：「这个人赶鬼，无非是靠着鬼王别西卜啊。」

zhTraditional.text: 但法利賽人聽見，就說：「這個人趕鬼，無非是靠着鬼王別西卜啊。」

en.text: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Everykingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣知道他们的意念，就对他们说：「凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒场；一城一家自相纷争，必站立不住；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說：「凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；一城一家自相紛爭，必站立不住；

en.text: IfSatan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

zhSimplified.text: 若撒但赶逐撒但，就是自相纷争，他的国怎能站得住呢？

zhTraditional.text: 若撒但趕逐撒但，就是自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？

en.text: IfI by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

zhSimplified.text: 我若靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟赶鬼又靠着谁呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的是非。

zhTraditional.text: 我若靠着別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠着誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。

en.text: Butif I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

zhSimplified.text: 我若靠着 神的灵赶鬼，这就是 神的国临到你们了。

zhTraditional.text: 我若靠着上帝的靈趕鬼，這就是上帝的國臨到你們了。

en.text: Orhow can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

zhSimplified.text: 人怎能进壮士家里，抢夺他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壮士，才可以抢夺他的家财。

zhTraditional.text: 人怎能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家財。

en.text: “Hewho is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’ t gather with me, scatters.

zhSimplified.text: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」

zhTraditional.text: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」

en.text: ThereforeI tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

zhSimplified.text: 所以我告诉你们：「人一切的罪和亵渎的话都可得赦免，惟独亵渎圣灵，总不得赦免。

zhTraditional.text: 所以我告訴你們：「人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。

en.text: Whoeverspeaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

zhSimplified.text: 凡说话干犯人子的，还可得赦免；惟独说话干犯圣灵的，今世来世总不得赦免。」 （路6·43—45）

zhTraditional.text: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨說話干犯聖靈的，今世來世總不得赦免。」 （路6‧43－45）

en.text: “Eithermake the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们或以为树好，果子也好；树坏，果子也坏；因为看果子就可以知道树。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們或以為樹好，果子也好；樹壞，果子也壞；因為看果子就可以知道樹。

en.text: Youoffspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

zhSimplified.text: 毒蛇的种类！你们既是恶人，怎能说出好话来呢？因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。

zhTraditional.text: 毒蛇的種類！你們既是惡人，怎能說出好話來呢？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。

en.text: Thegood man out of his good treasure bringsout good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

zhSimplified.text: 善人从他心里所存的善就发出善来；恶人从他心里所存的恶就发出恶来。

zhTraditional.text: 善人從他心裏所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他心裏所存的惡就發出惡來。

en.text: Itell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

zhSimplified.text: 我又告诉你们，凡人所说的闲话，当审判的日子，必要句句供出来；

zhTraditional.text: 我又告訴你們，凡人所說的閒話，當審判的日子，必要句句供出來；

en.text: Forby your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为要凭你的话定你为义，也要凭你的话定你有罪。」 （可8·11—12；路11·29—32）

zhTraditional.text: 因為要憑你的話定你為義，也要憑你的話定你有罪。」 （可8‧11－12；路11‧29－32）

en.text: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

zhSimplified.text: 当时，有几个文士和法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，我们愿意你显个神迹给我们看。」

zhTraditional.text: 當時，有幾個文士和法利賽人對耶穌說：「夫子，我們願意你顯個神蹟給我們看。」

en.text: But he answered them, “Anevil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「一个邪恶淫乱的世代求看神迹，除了先知约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们看。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「一個邪惡淫亂的世代求看神蹟，除了先知約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。

en.text: Foras Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 约拿三日三夜在大鱼肚腹中，人子也要这样三日三夜在地里头。

zhTraditional.text: 約拿三日三夜在大魚肚腹中，人子也要這樣三日三夜在地裏頭。

en.text: Themen of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

zhSimplified.text: 当审判的时候，尼尼微人要起来定这世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。看哪，在这里有一人比约拿更大！

zhTraditional.text: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裏有一人比約拿更大！

en.text: TheQueen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

zhSimplified.text: 当审判的时候，南方的女王要起来定这世代的罪；因为她从地极而来，要听所罗门的智慧话。看哪，在这里有一人比所罗门更大！」 （路11·24—26）

zhTraditional.text: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪； 因為她從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪，在這裏有一人比所羅門更大！」 （路11‧24－26）

en.text: “Whenan unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’ t find it.

zhSimplified.text: 「污鬼离了人身，就在无水之地过来过去，寻求安歇之处，却寻不着。

zhTraditional.text: 「污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇之處，卻尋不着。

en.text: Thenhe says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

zhSimplified.text: 于是说：『我要回到我所出来的屋里去。』到了，就看见里面空闲，打扫干净，修饰好了，

zhTraditional.text: 於是說：『我要回到我所出來的屋裏去。』到了，就看見裏面空閒，打掃乾淨，修飾好了，

en.text: Thenhe goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

zhSimplified.text: 便去另带了七个比自己更恶的鬼来，都进去住在那里。那人末后的景况比先前更不好了。这邪恶的世代也要如此。」 （可3·31—35；路8·19—21）

zhTraditional.text: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裏。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。這邪惡的世代也要如此。」 （可3‧31－35；路8‧19－21）

en.text: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣还对众人说话的时候，不料他母亲和他弟兄站在外边，要与他说话。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌還對眾人說話的時候，不料他母親和他弟兄站在外邊，要與他說話。

en.text: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

zhSimplified.text: 有人告诉他说：「看哪，你母亲和你弟兄站在外边，要与你说话。」

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要與你說話。」

en.text: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Whois my mother? Who are my brothers?”

zhSimplified.text: 他却回答那人说：「谁是我的母亲？谁是我的弟兄？」

zhTraditional.text: 他卻回答那人說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」

en.text: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

zhSimplified.text: 就伸手指着门徒，说：「看哪，我的母亲，我的弟兄。

zhTraditional.text: 就伸手指着門徒，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。

en.text: Forwhoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

zhSimplified.text: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母亲了。」

zhTraditional.text: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
